operating_principle: Observed-condition risk is independent. Model outputs are planning outlooks and never change risk points.
inference_boundary: Historical and 2026-3 screens replay saved leave-one-building-flock-out predictions. Arbitrary future-cycle scoring requires the upstream 85-feature transformer.

models.boundary: Target is last recorded population divided by beginning population; not independently verified harvest or sales recovery.

models.observation_window: Days 7, 14, and 21; held between and afterward
models.boundary: No Day 28 model refresh is claimed. The recorded Day 35 measurement replaces the forecast when available.
